summary: Houthis claimed an attack on the Saudi Ministry of Defense in Riyadh. The US military is reducing troop presence across Middle East bases and the State Department ordered staff reductions at diplomatic posts, while the US embassy ordered all American staff and families to leave Saudi Arabia. A drone strike targeted an IRGC missile launcher in the Sirik mountains of Hormozgan Province, Iran.

sections.executive_summary: Houthis claimed an attack on the Saudi Ministry of Defense in Riyadh, marking a significant escalation in Red Sea hostilities. The United States is simultaneously drawing down military forces across the region and evacuating diplomatic personnel from Saudi Arabia, signaling anticipation of broader conflict. A drone strike destroyed an IRGC missile launcher in southern Iran, while Saudi Arabia confirmed casualties at Dammam airport.
